ideas.pitch: A multilingual voice-first health guidance and symptom triage kiosk for rural communities, tailored for offline-first deployment.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering society through intelligent innovation: Healthcare accessibility in rural semi-urban areas
ideas.title: GraminArogya
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the core theme of empowering society through intelligent innovation, mimicking the proven social impact strategy of SAGACITY.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent distress-detection wearable companion app with automated location pinging and whisper-activated emergency dispatch.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering society through intelligent innovation: Women safety and societal empowerment
ideas.title: NariSuraksha
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organized by WIE (Women in Engineering) IEEE SB, safety and women empowerment solutions naturally resonate deeply with the judging panel's core mission.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered vernacular accessibility assistant for elderly citizens to navigate complex government welfare schemes easily.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering society through intelligent innovation: Bridging the digital divide for elderly and vulnerable groups
ideas.title: SahayakAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven grand-prize winning user-centric accessibility pattern adapted for local government schemes, winning over judges looking for high societal empathy.

ideas.pitch: A localized crop yield and extreme weather risk forecasting tool for smallholder farmers using lightweight regression models.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering society through intelligent innovation: Agricultural sustainability and climate resilience
ideas.title: AgriForecast
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features concrete statistical rigor and clear, quantifiable economic impact, appealing to judges valuing technical depth within a 12-hour constraint.

ideas.pitch: A real-time dynamic ambulance routing dashboard that bypasses congestion blackspots using crowd-sourced traffic density inputs.
ideas.problem_statement: Empowering society through intelligent innovation: Emergency medical response optimization
ideas.title: PathMitra
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a life-or-death urban infrastructure problem with clear measurable time savings, matching winning emergency routing hackathon entries.
